name: SEPTA API
tagline: Real-time and schedule data for Philadelphia regional transit
description: Public SEPTA developer APIs for Regional Rail arrivals, TrainView, Next-to-Arrive, and schedules; bus and trolley locations, detours, schedules, and stops; service alerts, elevator outages, and GTFS/GTFS-RT feeds. The documentation does not claim uniform real-time vehicle coverage for subway/elevated lines.

auth.details: No authentication required; public endpoints are openly accessible without API keys or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unlimited free public access; no published quotas

use_cases: get next regional rail arrivals for a SEPTA station
track live bus or trolley vehicle locations on a route
look up train schedule between two regional rail stations
fetch current SEPTA service alerts and detours
get real-time train positions on the regional rail network
